item.patternchecker.pattern_checker_tool: Accessory/checker: keep it in your inventory or accessory slot to add a draggable module to AE2 encoding terminals; right-click only opens the checker.
patternchecker.menu.panel.title: Checker module
patternchecker.menu.title: Pattern Checker

patternchecker.msg.none: No loaded ME networks found in this dimension.

patternchecker.msg.networkHeader: Network #%s: %s patterns (%s providers / %s containers / %s storage), %s errors, %s warnings
